title: Deliver one durable computerless turn
description:
Purpose: deliver the smallest running slice that is recognizably Chatticus.

Definition of Done:
- An authenticated household member addresses a named bot in a channel.
- One OpenAI text-only loop runs without summoning a computer.
- Messages, turn state, progress, and completion are durable and tenant-scoped.
- A watcher sees coalesced progress through SSE scoped to that turn.
- Disconnecting the watcher cannot stop or corrupt the turn.
- The deployed application compute has no idle floor.

Not included: tools, browser use, task tracking, approvals, and mid-turn escalation.
